description: This file defines an internal interface IInternalStreamProvider within the Orleans.Streams namespace, providing methods to obtain producer and consumer interfaces for asynchronous streaming.

classes.name: IInternalStreamProvider
classes.description: An internal interface for stream providers to access producer and consumer interfaces based on stream identifiers.

methods.name: GetProducerInterface
methods.description: Returns an internal asynchronous batch observer for the specified stream.

methods.name: GetConsumerInterface
methods.description: Returns an internal asynchronous observable for the specified stream.
